name: transport-resource-throughput-matched
title: Transported resource throughput · matched RNS policy
summary: Relay the identical transported-resource workload with both relay interfaces configured for RNS's 10 Mbps / 16 KiB policy.
notes: Controlled policy comparison: identical transported link and driver with both implementations configured for the stock RNS bitrate and MTU tier.
description: The transported-resource relay workload repeated with both relay interfaces explicitly configured for 10 Mbps, selecting the 16,384-byte MTU tier. The fixed wire driver establishes one genuine transported link before timing and then drives balanced full-duplex LINK/DATA frames in RESOURCE context. This is the policy-matched counterpart to the default-policy switching result.
conformance: A valid transported link is established before timing; every issued LINK/RESOURCE frame is forwarded once, in order and byte-exact, in both directions, with exact directional payload totals and zero missing, duplicate, corrupt, reordered, unexpected, or timed-out frames.
